· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0789→-0.0188) + Diagnosing improvement, potential trend reversal signal

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($84.34) + Potential for medium-term trend reversal upon breakout

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) + Specifying entry condition on support confirmation at 82.77 and enhanced buying on resistance breakout at 84.34
